## Personality

Jane Andrews is a plain, conscientious, and plodding individual known for her unshakeable nerves. Highly skilled in domestic science, she has earned honors in the subject. She is motivated to devote her entire life to teaching and intends never to marry.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## History

Jane Andrews participated in local social gatherings alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), including the game of dares party where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) injured her ankle. As a member of their peer group, she was among the schoolmates who visited and comforted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) during her weeks of bed rest. Later, Jane joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) on a trip to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) for a charity concert, driving there with her brother [Billy](../character/billy.md). Following the event, Jane shared supper with her friends and took part in their conversation during the carriage ride home.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P2](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P3](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P4](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P7](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane-andrews.md)

Jane Andrews is a friend and classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), whom she supports by lending books and visiting when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) breaks her ankle after falling off a roof. The two also travel together alongside other peers to attend a charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).

- Comrade of — traveling together to a concert in a buggy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>
- Friend of — classmate who lends her books  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002)</sub>

### [Billy](../character/billy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy--jane-andrews.md)

Jane and [Billy](../character/billy.md) are brother and sister. [Billy](../character/billy.md) acts as a driver for Jane and her friends, transporting them to and from the charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) in his buggy.

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--jane-andrews.md)

Jane and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) are social acquaintances and fellow schoolmates in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). They travel together in a buggy driven by Jane's brother [Billy](../character/billy.md) to attend a charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), sharing supper and conversation on the ride home.

- Comrade of — traveling together to a concert in a buggy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>
